What do you want to improve first?

This tool creates a plan on your device. It does not contact customers, publish anything or start a paid membership.

Your action plan

Choose one goal to build a plan.

Four practical steps

  1. Check your practice name, location, specialty, website and public contact information.
  2. Explain services, languages, accessibility, appointment steps and the best way to contact the practice.
  3. Create one general educational topic with clear medical limits and emergency directions.
  4. Track listing use separately from appointments, patients, clinical outcomes and revenue.

Keep these rules in mind

  • Never collect private health information in these public tools.
  • Do not diagnose, promise treatment results or make unsupported medical claims.
  • Paying for membership never changes licensing, safety information or ordinary directory placement.
